<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 276.0666. Assuming this is a [M+Na]⁺ adduct, the neutral mass is ≈ 276.0666 – 22.9892 = 253.0774 Da. The formula C₁₂H₁₃O₆ matches this neutral mass (exact mass = 253.0712 Da) within typical instrument tolerance, making it the most plausible molecular formula for the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H13O6</final_answer>
